summary: Global image-upload guidance UX. Every P01 Add/Edit/Replace image entry now shows the best pixel size and aspect ratio: Channels 960×960 (1:1), Watch 640×960 (2:3), Topics 960×720 (4:3), Courses 640×960 (2:3), Projects 960×420 (16:7), Brand Logo/Favicon/manual URL icon 512×512 (1:1). The shared resource form switches guidance by surface. RPD, SSOT, Functional Contract and Acceptance Matrix UX-46 are updated. OWNER explicitly requested publish; this uses OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE for a bounded presentation-only change. Exact-candidate Preview remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and Real Use remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. No schema/data/auth/security/provider/updater mechanism or Production change.
